Join us for a behind-the-scenes tour of Wellington's iconic St James Theatre and The Opera House. Discover hidden stories, architectural splendour, and rich theatrical history as you step behind the velvet curtain and explore two of the city's most beloved performance spaces. Led by expert guides, this tour takes you on a journey through over a century of theatre magic. Tread the boards in the footsteps of legendary performers. Uncover the secrets of stagecraft and marvel at the breathtaking details of these heritage-listed buildings. From opulent foyers and ornate auditoriums to backstage corridors brimming with history, you'll see the theatres as you've never seen them before.

id: Bootleg Rascal - ‘Asleep In The Machine’ 10th Anniversary Tour-Valhalla Wellington, Wellington -Ticket Master
name: Bootleg Rascal - ‘Asleep In The Machine’ 10th Anniversary Tour
long_description:
To celebrate the tenth anniversary of their critically-praised and fan-adored debut album 'Asleep In The Machine', Yugambeh/Gold Coast-based duo Bootleg Rascal have just announced a five-date New Zealand tour, taking place in December off the back of their Australian tour.

Stopping off in Wellington, Auckland, Christchurch and Queenstown, the band will perform tracks from 'Asleep In The Machine', plus their most recent and fourth self-titled studio album, and all the classics from their extended discography.

'Asleep In The Machine' is one of Bootleg Rascal's most career-defining moments. Performing the title track on triple j's Like A Version, and amassing 35 million streams across Spotify and Apple Music, the record solidified the duo's signature blend of indie-rock, hip-hop, electronica and dub, ultimately serving as the catalyst for a decade of relentless touring and a fiercely loyal global fanbase.
